}}'''Renald Macer''' is a sergeant in the [[Queen's Guards]] in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Renald Macer}}

== Appearance ==
He is bald-headed with a mustache. He is a stout man with wide hands and a calm temperament.

== Activities ==
[[Birgitte Silverbow]] bursts in on him dicing with [[Matrim Cauthon]], who was caught sneaking into the Palace.
